objective: Egg Garden server: Hatchling Valley world and lighting, six plots with beds, pads, creatures and prompts, the pad and status loop, Request and prompt handling, hatch announcements, GardenStatus and Fx publishing, and saved profiles with coalesced writes and the GardenIncome leaderboard.
acceptance_criteria: Only the files listed for GARDEN-004 in docs/architecture/garden.md section 1 change
Request and both bed prompts enforce every check in decision 0008; refused requests change nothing

Every saved write uses the UpdateAsync re-apply pattern with at most one write per player per 7 s, the 60 s autosave, a final write on leave and in BindToClose; a failed load never writes defaults; stores are GardenProfile<suffix> and GardenIncome<suffix>
Hatch outcomes are rolled once and applied as fixed outcomes on the stored record
Loop order follows docs/architecture/garden.md section 4.3; Fx payloads follow section 5
World under 6,000 parts, each plot under 300 parts plus creatures
Every new mesh, track and sound has a docs/assets/register.md row before use
Leave and rejoin after 10 minutes pays the predicted offline amount and keeps every egg, creature and pad coin (Studio, DataStores on)
Server frame time under 8 ms with 6 full gardens (MicroProfiler capture)
verification: CI; Studio playtests with notes and timings; QA review (GARDEN-006) of remotes and saves
notes: High risk: saved player data with offline income and a remote contract. Can start against stubs of the section 3 signatures before GARDEN-003 lands. Delete src/garden/.gitkeep with the first script. PRODUCTION_UNIVERSE_ID stays nil. Log the encoded size of a full test profile to confirm decision 0008's 12 KB estimate.
evidence: Local 2026-10-25: stylua src/garden clean; selene src/garden 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 parse errors; rojo build garden.project.json -o build/garden.rbxl OK; relay.project.json and night.project.json still build. Lune not run here (GARDEN-003 owns the tests).

Files: src/garden/{GardenServer.server,State,Remotes,Profiles,Plots,World}.luau; src/garden/.gitkeep deleted; src/relay/Models.luau +10 entries only (eggTree, bunny, frog, pup, cat, owl, fox, turtle, lion, dragon; existing entries unchanged); docs/assets/register.md +10 mesh rows. Server uses no audio, so no music or SFX rows were added here.

Request router: session and plot, string action, arg nil or string <= 32, shared 0.35 s limit (refusals inside it do not reset it), action table with the arg/no-arg rule, ^%d+$ ids; buyEgg checks 25 studs from the cart on the server root; like checks target loaded, not self, gate (IsFriendsWith cached per pair); release fires Fx before the model goes. Prompts: same session and rate limit, 12 studs on the server root, Hatch owner only (roll once with a fresh seed, apply the fixed outcome, full-garden notice), Water owner or gate-allowed helper.

Profiles: GardenProfile<suffix> and GardenIncome<suffix>; GetAsync x3 then offline (no writes); every change runs in memory and is queued; flush = one UpdateAsync of sanitize(old, now) + queued ops + snapshot(unbanked, now), at most one per 7 s, 60 s autosave, final flush on leave and in BindToClose (all in parallel); failed flush re-queues at the front; success adopts the stored result plus newer ops. Board SetAsync every 120 s only when floor(income) changed. PRODUCTION_UNIVERSE_ID stays nil.

Loop per garden.md 4.3: 5 Hz accrue, bank on pad (Fx collect per pad with >= 1 coin, one quiet bank op), 1 s gate guard; 1 Hz setPending, plot refresh (eggs ripen with time), GardenStatus JSON when changed, forecast board, Profiles.step, Top Gardens every 60 s.

Full test profile (80 creatures, 12 beds, 36 Index, max counters) encodes to about 9.1 KB (Python estimate with the same fields), under decision 0008's 12 KB; Profiles also prints each loaded profile's encoded size.

Instance names match GARDEN-005: Plot<n> Owner/Gate, Beds.Bed<i> (Locked, Egg, Planted, Ready, Soil with Hatch/Water prompts, Egg part), Pads.Pad<i> (Locked, Pending), Creatures.<id> (Id, S, M, Z, Pad, Hatched), Sign, Fence; cart prompt Shop; night lights under parts named Lamp and HangingEgg; windmill Model Sails pivoting on its Z axis.

Not yet done: Studio playtests (rejoin after 10 minutes with DataStores on, two-client water/like/closed gate, new-player timings), MicroProfiler with 6 full gardens, part-count reading (World prints it and sets Workspace.Garden Parts; plots are designed for about 250 parts each), CI run. Creature mesh facing (CREATURE_YAW in Plots.luau) and the egg tree and sakura placement need a Studio look.
